summary: The proof is correct. The prescribed-root census follows from disjoint adaptive cylinders with the stated path-variation cost. Every neighbor and endpoint used for positive-level depth preserves the whole root block and remains in the positive-level class, so the arbitrary positive multiplier is unchanged on each selected family. The normalizers, fourth-moment factors, constants, both height ranges, and transfer from the two auxiliary laws to the full original law are valid, including the boundary Pi(lambda)=1.
